summary.goal: Transform Planner from a plan-centric tool into a standalone app with organization context, initiative grouping, and Linear-style navigation
summary.context: Currently plans exist in isolation with no tenant context, no grouping mechanism, and top-nav only navigation. For Planner to work as a standalone product, it needs: (1) schema for org/initiative/user context, (2) left sidebar navigation pattern, (3) three main views - Initiatives, Plans, Roadmap

acceptance_criteria.description: Organization and Initiative tables exist in schema with proper FKs
Plans have org_id (required) and initiative_id (optional) foreign keys
Left sidebar is always visible on desktop with collapse toggle
Left sidebar is slide-out drawer on mobile (<768px)
Sidebar shows: quick actions, global views, initiatives list with nested plans
Initiatives view shows all initiatives with status, plan counts
Plans view shows filtered/searchable plan list (reworked from current)
Roadmap view shows timeline with initiatives and plans, cross-dependencies

out_of_scope: Multi-org switching UI (schema ready, UI deferred)
